design.name: 冰夷
design.brief: Bingyi (冰夷), the river god of the Shan Hai Jing ('in the Abyss of Congji, three hundred ren deep, dwells Bingyi, with a human face, riding two dragons'). A tall, slender aquatic deity about 4 m tall with a calm, pale-blue, stylized mask-like face (not a realistic person), long flowing hair and robes that turn into sculpted frozen water and ice crystals at the hem, standing on the heads of TWO serpentine Chinese ice dragons (NOT Western dragons; pale jade and frost white, big carved scales) that rise in a twisting pair from below; total height with the dragons about 9 m. Magenta-violet thunder corruption glows in cracks of the ice robe and in the dragons' eyes; a glowing magenta core on the god's chest (weak spot). Elegant, cold and divine.
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the earlier rosters (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast, huodou sighthound): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges. Lightning is painted as OPAQUE glowing magenta-violet zig-zag veins and solid sculpted spark shapes on the body (never transparent bolts, particles, smoke or glow halos); fur, hair and feathers as a few large carved clumps.
